rows.name: mitmproxy — standalone binary with built-in Modify Body
rows.reason: Standalone mitmproxy modifies buffered response HTML without Node/Python development setup. It does not modify later JavaScript-created DOM; streaming disables body modification. Successful eBay archiving remains undocumented and untested.

rows.name: node-http-proxy Node.js library
rows.reason: Programmable HTTP(S) response proxy requires Node/npm and custom JavaScript, conflicting with an ecosystem-avoidance preference, not a mandatory ban. Retain as unverified low-fit engineering, not ready-made.

rows.name: ArchiveWeb.page clean-profile troubleshooting
rows.reason: Clean-profile trial addresses plausible extension conflicts/extension-origin errors. No relevant error or no improvement means source does not explain listing failure. Search metadata dates guide after question.

rows.name: mitmproxy
rows.reason: Rewrites HTML via replacements/Python addons. HTTPS needs trusted proxy CA; replacements edit bytes, robust structure needs a parser. Does not establish successful Archiveweb.page recording of dynamic eBay listings.

rows.name: Charles Proxy
rows.reason: Charles Proxy supports location-scoped response-body rewriting and documented HTTPS setup. It fits the proxy route; whether source rewriting fixes the specific eBay recording remains unknown.

rows.name: Charles — Rewrite tool
rows.reason: GUI body rewriting supports attribute substitutions, not live DOM. HTTPS needs host-specific SSL Proxying and trust. Trial available; price/runtime packaging unverified. eBay capture success unknown.

rows.name: Privoxy — content filter with HTTPS inspection
rows.reason: Privoxy substitutes source HTML through filter/action files. Verify FEATURE_HTTPS_INSPECTION in the package; compiling TLS support may undermine low-setup preferences. Archive behavior remains unverified.

rows.name: Chrome DevTools Local Overrides
rows.reason: Built-in selected-request HTML/fetch/XHR overrides enable attribute experiments without proxy. Uses saved replacements, not every-live-response transformation; edit source, not only Elements DOM. Archiveweb.page interaction untested.

rows.name: CharLS
rows.reason: CharLS implements C++ JPEG-LS compression/decompression, not Charles Proxy. No documented operational connection links it to browser HTTP(S) interception or delivered-HTML modification; the task surface mismatches.

rows.name: node-http-proxy Node.js library
rows.reason: Although programmable response modification is supported, this library requires Node.js/npm and custom proxy code, directly conflicting with the request to avoid learning that ecosystem.

rows.name: Fiddler Classic with FiddlerScript
rows.reason: FiddlerScript OnBeforeResponse can decode and replace HTML before browser receipt. Requires rules and HTTPS decryption; substitutions do not act on a live DOM. Archiveweb.page compatibility remains untested.

rows.name: SingleFile
rows.reason: Saves visibly opened listing as self-contained tab/frame HTML. Replaces Archiveweb.page workflow; extension snapshot, not interactive WARC/WACZ recording. Scripts removed by default; offline interactivity unassured.

rows.name: Privoxy content filters
rows.reason: URL-scoped HTML-source attribute substitutions use regex, not DOM selectors. HTTPS requires inspection-capable build/configuration and trusted generated certificates; retrieved 4.2.0 manual was undated.

rows.name: Charles Proxy
rows.reason: Charles applies URL-scoped replacements to response bodies before delivery, supporting HTML attribute edits; HTTPS requires SSL proxying and certificate trust, and browser-DOM execution is absent.

rows.name: CharLS
rows.reason: CharLS implements JPEG-LS image compression in C++; it provides no HTTP interception or HTML/DOM rewriting mechanism for the described browser workflow.
